name: autobahn

about.summary: WebSocket and WAMP in Python for Twisted and asyncio
WebSocket and WAMP in Python for Twisted and asyncio

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "26.7.1"

package:
  name: autobahn
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/a/autobahn/autobahn-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c6949a2c6eb95fb1c218837dbda0a59abbbebafb8b11098551c01a7061dfd245

build:
  number: 0
  script: python -m pip install . -vv --no-build-isolation --no-deps
  skip:
    - match(python, "<3.11")
  python:
    entry_points:
      - wamp = autobahn.__main__:_main

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - hatchling
        - cffi >=2.0.0
        - setuptools
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - hatchling
    - cffi >=2.0.0
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python
    - txaio >=25.12.2
    - cryptography >=3.4.6
    - hyperlink >=21.0.0
    - msgpack-python >=1.0.2
    - ujson >=4.0.2
    - cbor2 >=5.2.0
    - py-ubjson >=0.16.1

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - autobahn
        - autobahn.rawsocket
        - autobahn.wamp
        - autobahn.websocket
        - autobahn.util
        - autobahn.nvx
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - zope.interface >=5.2.0
        - twisted >=24.3.0
        - attrs >=20.3.0
    script:
      - wamp -h

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: WebSocket and WAMP in Python for Twisted and asyncio
  homepage: https://github.com/crossbario/autobahn-python
  repository: https://github.com/crossbario/autobahn-python
  documentation: https://autobahn-python.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - synapticarbors

about.summary: WebSocket and WAMP in Python for Twisted and asyncio
